title: Critique and Mathematical Correction of Inverse Portal Theory
summary: We analyze the recently proposed Inverse Portal Theory by Dr. Vu Van, which models black holes as dimensional crossover points where $D(r) \to 0$. We identify a critical mathematical error in the original formulation where the absorption function $A(r)$ incorrectly vanished rather than diverged at the crossover point. We present a corrected mathematical framework using a divergent power-law formulation for $A(r)$, successfully preserving the author original hypothesis of total photon consumption and subsequent transfer to an inverse world.

review.reason: Critiques a black hole crossover theory and proposes a mathematical correction to it.
